findings.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:12 — The new fallback order and eager locale loading have no tests, so user/site/English fallback and lazy-load regressions can ship unnoticed.

goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:12 — The new fallback order and eager locale loading have no tests, so user/site/English fallback and lazy-load regressions can ship unnoticed.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces new non-trivial logic in config/initializers/i18n.rb: a custom FallbackLocaleList class with specific fallback ordering logic ([locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact) and an ensure_loaded! method. This is new functionality that affects internationalization behavior. The finding correctly identifies that there are no tests visible in this diff for this new logic, which could lead to regressions in the fallback chain going unnoticed. This is a legitimate concern about missing test coverage for newly added code, not a bug or hallucination.
